title: Computational Job Planning
body:
This Signature record covers Computational Job Planning within the High-Performance Computing Workflows Signature Database. Plans computational jobs, dependencies, resource allocation and reproducible execution. It is Manon's original design for this topic, written for the Signature ecosystem rather than copied from any outside source.

How it works. Workflow method: jobs, dependencies, and resources are declared once, executed reproducibly with provenance, and profiled for cost and speed. The Signature version keeps the same honest structure as the public record: stated inputs, a repeatable procedure, stated outputs, and explicit limits. In a simple case the method is applied to a single, well-defined item; in a compounded case several items are combined and their interactions are tracked; in the most complex case the full chain is carried end to end with checks at each stage.

Worked example. The demo program attached to this record executes the worked calculation for this topic at build time, and its output is stored beside the code so any reader can compare the two. The numbers in the demo are ordinary working values for this topic, chosen so the arithmetic can be checked by hand as well as by running the program.

Scope and limits. This record describes Manon's original designs; it does not claim a live deployment, a vendor product, or an agency endorsement. Where a design is speculative it is labeled as a design, and the demo shows the calculation rather than a deployed system.
